featured_reviews.name: Kaustubh Kakade
featured_reviews.review_text:
We had a wonderful experience at the hospital and are truly grateful for the care we received. Dr. Chandan More is an expert gynecologist. What we appreciated the most was her genuine encouragement and confidence in guiding patients toward normal delivery wherever possible. Both the doctors are extremely kind, approachable, and attentive—they made sure to regularly check on all patients and address any concerns with patience.

The staff at the hospital is very professional, well-trained, and experienced. They were always supportive, responsive, and ensured that we felt comfortable and cared for throughout our stay. The overall environment was clean, calm, and reassuring, which made a big difference during such an important time.

We have had two experiences at this hospital, and both have been very positive and smooth. We truly appreciate the dedication, warmth, and commitment shown by the entire team. We would wholeheartedly recommend this hospital to anyone looking for safe, compassionate, and trustworthy maternity care.

Their calm demeanor in the delivery room made all the difference. If you are looking for a knowledgeable and compassionate gynecologist, look no further!"😇

featured_reviews.name: Jane Joseph
featured_reviews.review_text:
I visited India for a wedding in February 2025 without knowing I was pregnant. While looking for doctors in the area, I came across Dr. Chandan More’s profile and decided to visit her for my initial check-ups.

What I loved about Dr. Chandan is how approachable, caring, and genuinely invested she was in my case. At one point, when one of my reports wasn’t perfect, she personally consoled me, guided me through the next steps, and reminded me to stay positive. Thanks to her reassurance and care, I recently delivered a healthy baby boy in the US.

Even though she knew I might continue my care abroad, she still gave me her full attention and even shared her personal number so I could reach out in case of any concerns or for a second opinion from the US.

Also, the nurses at her clinic are very sweet and know you personally — they make every visit feel comfortable and warm.

featured_reviews.name: suvarna hatkar
featured_reviews.review_text: My husband had pain in the left knee from July. We being senior citizens wanted a doctor who can listen to us calmly and boost our confidence. Our orthopaedic Dr. Parelkar from Mandapeshwar hospital had stopped practising and we found Dr. Devanand More. We were browsing on google, going through reviews and after getting satisfied rang the hospital for an appointment with Dr. More that was when they said that he no longer visits them. From google we got the name of his hospital Sharvil Maternity, Orthopedic and Surgical hospital at holy cross road.and visited him today. He is an excellent Dr. Heard our problems calmly, made us comfortable, answered all our questions with a smile. Felt 100% satisfied. Thank you Dr. God bless you.

featured_reviews.name: Sneha Mhapsekar
featured_reviews.review_text: Dr Devananda More is a gem of a person and an extremely empathetic doctor. I had visited him for both my parents. I am extremely grateful to him for my father for attending him during an emergency, taking so much care and help him recover for his recurrent issue. I often consult him for any medical advice for my entire family as we all trust him and his expertise.We also found the nursing staff very caring and hospital clean and hygienic.Would highly recommend him for genuine advice and treatment.

We straightaway came back from the hospital. This is very unprofessional and wasting patient's time. I had taken time out from my working day and was not expecting so much wait.

featured_reviews.name: jose coelho
featured_reviews.review_text: I went to many doctors both Mumbai and Goa and finally someone introduced me to Dr. Devanand More. He fixed my knee issue in a few months time with no surgery. Medicines and exercise healed me and I’m able to walk and travel. Many a time he is late at the clinic, this is due to surgeries, he does many of them to make a patient feel good.
